title: Share of US outpatient antibiotic prescriptions that were unnecessary (2024)

source.name: Outpatient Antibiotic Prescriptions — United States
source.publisher: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)

notes: CDC's 2024 annual report counted 255.9 million outpatient oral antibiotic prescriptions; a CDC-linked estimate puts roughly 1 in 3 outpatient antibiotic prescriptions as unnecessary. Necessary/unnecessary split rounded from that ratio.
